name: skynet
description: Optimize DSPy programs against your own metric with Skynet, and manage the runs.

interface.longDescription:
Skynet improves a DSPy program against a metric that you write. You give the program in run.py, a few test cases and a score(input, output, expected) function. Skynet runs DSPy optimizers such as GEPA in a sandbox, scores each new version, and returns the best version with its score next to the starting score. Repository runs start from the Skynet app.

With this plugin, your assistant checks a run spec before it runs, suggests a spending limit, starts the run only after you agree to the limit, follows its progress, and shows the result. It can also list your runs and stop a run. A run spends at most the limit you set from your existing Skynet balance. Unused budget is released when the run ends. You need a Skynet account at skynetml.com.
capabilities: Check a run spec and suggest a spending limit
Start an optimization run with a limit you approve
Follow a run and show its result
defaultPrompt: Optimize this DSPy program with Skynet against my test cases.
What is the status of my last Skynet run?

positive.description: Check a run spec before it runs
positive.prompt: Check whether this Skynet run spec is valid and tell me what limit to set: a DSPy program that classifies support tickets, with 6 labeled cases and an exact-match metric.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_run once. Reports the static check results, the minimum and suggested max_cost_cents, and the spendable balance. Does not start a run.

positive.description: Start a run after the user agrees to a limit
positive.prompt: Optimize the ticket classifier DSPy program with Skynet. I agree to a limit of 5 dollars.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_run first, then start_run with max_cost_cents 500. Returns the optimization_id and the run status.

positive.description: Follow a run and show its result
positive.prompt: How is my last Skynet run doing? Show the result if it is done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest run with list_runs, calls get_run, and reports the status and spend. For a finished run, shows the baseline score, the best score and the best version.

positive.prompt: List my Skynet runs that failed.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_runs with status failed and lists each run's name, status and creation time.

positive.description: Stop a run the user names
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the running run with list_runs, confirms which run to stop, then calls stop_run and reports that spend stopped.

negative.prompt: Add 50 dollars of credit to my Skynet account.
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or credits and does not process payments. A run spends at most a limit the user approves from the balance of an existing Skynet account.
